summary: Executed targeted backend + UI verification for admin-origin/CORS hardening. Preview admin login and navigation work. Source-side parser/CSRF protections largely pass. Production bug remains pending user secret update and still reproduces as 403.

critical.issue: Production still returns 403 'Nicht erlaubter Ursprung der Anfrage.' with Origin=https://manucreator.de. Response also shows Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials=true, confirming production secret/runtime config is still wildcard-based and not yet corrected.

minor.issue: When Origin is https://subtle-motion-8.preview.emergentagent.com, Access-Control-Allow-Origin is returned as https://subtle-motion-8.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud instead of echoing the exact request origin. Other configured origins echo correctly.

action_items: Production panel secret CORS_ORIGINS must be set to explicit live origins (no wildcard) and redeployed; then re-run live login verification.
Investigate preview edge behavior where Origin=preview.emergentagent.com receives ACAO for cluster domain; enforce exact ACAO echo for that configured origin path.
After production secret update, rerun one full live admin flow: login -> /me -> refresh rotation -> logout from https://manucreator.de/verwaltung.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: studio/origins.py correctly canonicalizes explicit origins and rejects wildcard/null/scheme-relative/credentials/path-query-fragment/wildcard-netloc/malformed-port entries.
PASS: studio/admin_auth.same_origin now relies on shared explicit_origins policy and blocks missing/null/malicious/scheme-port mismatch origins and spoofed forwarded headers.
PASS: backend/server.py CORS middleware uses explicit_origins() with credentials enabled and no wildcard in source env.

RISK: CORS middleware is initialized at import with allow_origins=explicit_origins(); runtime env changes require process restart (expected), but deployment secret mismatch still causes live failures until redeploy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested preview admin smoke flow

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Used existing admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and isolated lockout test email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview verification done against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. New test file covers parser canonicalization/rejections, missing env fail-fast, wildcard fail-closed, shared parser usage, allowed/disallowed origins, spoofed header rejection, preflight checks, lockout behavior. Remaining blockers are production secret mismatch and preview-origin ACAO mismatch for emergentagent alias.
rca of the issue: User-reported production login failure reproduces exactly: wildcard-origin production secret causes same_origin rejection before auth. Reproduction: POST https://manucreator.de/api/admin/auth/refresh with Origin=https://manucreator.de returns 403 detail 'Nicht erlaubter Ursprung der Anfrage.' and ACAO '*'. Mitigation: set explicit production CORS_ORIGINS in deployment Secrets, redeploy, then retest live login once. Separate minor RCA: on preview gateway alias, ACAO normalizes to cluster-domain origin for one configured alias, causing strict exact-origin assertion failure in automated tests.
